entries.en: The film depicts the dematerialization of a chair inside a glowing chamber.
entries.zh: 电影描绘了一把椅子在发光舱室内化为无形的过程。

entries.en: The batboy gathered the discarded bats after the inning.
entries.zh: 这一局结束后，棒球队球童收起了搁在一旁的球棒。

entries.en: The musician brought a didgeridoo to the school's instrument demonstration.
entries.zh: 乐手带了一支迪吉里杜管，参加学校的乐器展示。

entries.en: The sleeping baby smiled beatifically as her grandmother watched.
entries.zh: 熟睡的婴儿安详幸福地微笑着，祖母在一旁望着她。

entries.en: The laboratory keeps the reference samples cryogenically preserved.
entries.zh: 实验室以低温冷冻方式保存参照样本。

entries.en: The glaciologist compared photographs taken ten years apart.
entries.zh: 冰川学家比较了相隔十年拍摄的照片。

entries.en: The larger workshop finally gave the potters enough elbowroom.
entries.zh: 更大的作坊终于给了陶工们足够的活动空间。

entries.meaningZh: 一大块；一堆〔英式非正式用语〕
entries.en: He pulled a thick wodge of receipts from his coat pocket.
entries.zh: 他从大衣口袋里掏出厚厚一叠收据。

entries.meaningZh: 多嘴的；大声叫嚣的〔非正式，含贬义〕
entries.en: The mouthy passenger kept arguing after everyone else had fallen silent.
entries.zh: 其他人都不再说话了，那个多嘴的乘客却还在争吵。

entries.meaningZh: 黏稠的；滑腻的〔美式俚语〕
entries.en: The mixture became goopy as she stirred in the last ingredient.
entries.zh: 她搅入最后一种配料时，混合物变得黏稠起来。

entries.en: The two unassociated events happened on the same afternoon.
entries.zh: 这两件互不相关的事发生在同一个下午。

entries.en: The council hoped the new railway would help repopulate the abandoned village.
entries.zh: 市政委员会希望新铁路能帮助那个废弃村庄重新迎来居民。

entries.en: The council voted to redesignate the old warehouse as a community centre.
entries.zh: 市政委员会投票决定把旧仓库重新定为社区中心。

entries.en: The scene works cinematically, though it would be difficult on stage.
entries.zh: 从电影角度看，这个场景很有效果，尽管搬到舞台上会很困难。

entries.en: The careful pasting of the torn pages took most of the afternoon.
entries.zh: 仔细粘合那些破损书页花去了大半个下午。

entries.en: The reformer attacked the institution's obscurantist resistance to public education.
entries.zh: 改革者抨击了该机构以蒙昧主义立场抵制公共教育的做法。

entries.en: The observatory hosted a workshop on recent research in helioseismology.
entries.zh: 天文台举办了一场关于日震学近期研究的研讨会。

entries.en: The shared garden encouraged intercommunal cooperation across the district.
entries.zh: 共用花园促进了区内不同社区之间的合作。

entries.en: The report examines the railway's corporatization and its effect on employees.
entries.zh: 报告考察了铁路的公司化及其对员工的影响。

entries.en: The instrument detected submillimeter changes in the panel's position.
entries.zh: 仪器检测到了面板位置的亚毫米级变化。

entries.en: She put the dried flowers in a sealable glass jar.
entries.zh: 她把干花放进了一个可密封的玻璃罐。

entries.en: We chatted desultorily while waiting for the late bus.
entries.zh: 等候晚点的公共汽车时，我们漫无边际地聊着天。

entries.en: The host poured a little cassis into a small glass.
entries.zh: 主人往小杯子里倒了少许黑醋栗酒。

entries.en: Her usual cheeriness returned when the rain finally stopped.
entries.zh: 雨终于停下来时，她恢复了平常的快活劲儿。

entries.en: The badlands stretched beyond the last village on the route.
entries.zh: 沿途最后一个村庄外面延伸着大片荒原。

entries.en: The collector slipped each stamp into a glassine envelope.
entries.zh: 收藏家把每枚邮票放进了薄玻璃纸信封。

entries.en: The festival is anthropologically interesting as well as visually striking.
entries.zh: 这个节日不但视觉上引人注目，也具有人类学研究价值。

entries.en: An experienced caver guided the group through the narrow passage.
entries.zh: 一位经验丰富的洞穴探察者带领队伍穿过狭窄通道。

entries.en: The children grew giggly during the magician's deliberately clumsy act.
entries.zh: 魔术师故意笨手笨脚地表演时，孩子们吃吃地笑个不停。

entries.en: The reviewer criticised the film's attractive but unhistorical costumes.
entries.zh: 评论者批评了电影中好看却不符合历史事实的服装。

entries.en: The researchers compared multispectral images of the same field.
entries.zh: 研究人员比较了同一块田地的多谱段图像。

entries.en: The broken vase had been packed in a box lined with Styrofoam.
entries.zh: 打碎的花瓶原先装在一个衬有泡沫聚苯乙烯的盒子里。

entries.en: The medical students reviewed a recorded episode of apnoea.
entries.zh: 医学生们回顾了一次有记录的呼吸暂停发作。

entries.en: The coin dealer placed a worn doit beside the silver pieces.
entries.zh: 硬币商把一枚磨损的荷兰古代小铜币放在银币旁。

entries.en: The inspection report noted an uninsulated wire inside the damaged casing.
entries.zh: 检查报告指出，损坏的外壳内有一根未绝缘的电线。

entries.en: We stopped at the carwash before returning the rental car.
entries.zh: 归还租车之前，我们去了洗车处。

entries.meaningZh: 活泼的；精神饱满的〔非正式〕
entries.en: The dancers ended the show with a kicky little routine.
entries.zh: 舞者们以一段活泼的小舞蹈结束了演出。

entries.meaningZh: 冗繁难懂的文字；官样文章〔非正式，含贬义〕
entries.en: The notice buried a simple instruction beneath pages of gobbledegook.
entries.zh: 这份通知把一个简单指示埋在了好几页晦涩的官样文章之下。

entries.en: After years of towny comforts, he found the isolated cottage challenging.
entries.zh: 享受多年城市生活的便利之后，他觉得住偏僻小屋很不适应。

entries.en: The committee agreed to revote after two ballots were found missing.
entries.zh: 发现两张选票丢失后，委员会同意重新投票。

entries.en: The crowd cheered deafeningly when the final score appeared.
entries.zh: 最终比分出现时，人群发出了震耳欲聋的欢呼。

entries.en: The editor supplied extratextual information about the author's journey.
entries.zh: 编辑补充了关于作者旅程的文本外信息。

entries.en: The club displayed old trophies from regional riflery competitions.
entries.zh: 俱乐部陈列了几座地区步枪打靶比赛的旧奖杯。

entries.en: The theology seminar compared different interpretations of kenosis.
entries.zh: 神学研讨课比较了对神性放弃的不同解释。

entries.meaningZh: 有油污的；能产生污迹的
entries.en: The smeary window blurred our view of the harbour.
entries.zh: 沾着油污的窗户让我们看不清港口。

entries.en: The old curtain label listed Terylene among the fibres.
entries.zh: 旧窗帘的标签把涤纶列为其中一种纤维。

entries.en: The novel finds beauty in the dailiness of cooking and cleaning.
entries.zh: 这部小说在做饭、打扫这些平淡日常中发现了美。

entries.en: Our footsteps sounded loud in the empty, echoey hall.
entries.zh: 空荡荡的大厅回声很大，我们的脚步听起来很响。

entries.en: I had to retype the final page after spilling tea on it.
entries.zh: 茶洒在最后一页上后，我不得不重新打这一页。

entries.en: Her interest in geoscience began during a school trip to the coast.
entries.zh: 她在一次学校海滨旅行中对地球科学产生了兴趣。

entries.en: The ballcarrier changed direction just before the defender reached him.
entries.zh: 防守队员快碰到他时，那位带球球员改变了方向。

entries.en: The pass was catchable, but he lost sight of the ball.
entries.zh: 这记传球本来接得住，但他没看清球。

entries.en: The audit uncovered a serious misallocation of maintenance funds.
entries.zh: 审计发现维修资金存在严重的分配不当。

entries.en: The legal seminar asked whether the fictional dispute was justiciable.
entries.zh: 法学研讨课讨论了那场虚构纠纷能否由法院裁决。

entries.en: The illustrator drew a waiflike child in an oversized coat.
entries.zh: 插画师画了一个穿着过大外套的瘦小孩子。

entries.en: The treaty balkanized the region into several hostile states.
entries.zh: 条约把该地区分裂成了几个彼此敌对的国家。

entries.meaningZh: 不易表达的；不可说出的
entries.en: The letter hints at an unsayable grief beneath her polite words.
entries.zh: 信中礼貌的言辞下面隐约藏着一种难以言说的悲伤。

entries.en: The anatomy diagram labels the gracilis beside the other thigh muscles.
entries.zh: 解剖图在其他大腿肌肉旁标出了股薄肌。

entries.en: The newsdesk requested a shorter version of the reporter's account.
entries.zh: 新闻组要求记者提供一版较短的报道。

entries.en: The engineering report described a component coated with Teflon.
entries.zh: 工程报告描述了一个涂有聚四氟乙烯的部件。

entries.en: A small bowl of harissa stood beside the grilled vegetables.
entries.zh: 烤蔬菜旁放着一小碗北非辣椒橄榄油酱。

entries.en: My grandaddy kept his old fishing rod behind the kitchen door.
entries.zh: 我爷爷把他的旧钓鱼竿放在厨房门后。

entries.en: The smokiness of the room made the distant doorway hard to see.
entries.zh: 房间里烟雾弥漫，远处的门口很难看清。

entries.en: The laboratory compared two mycobacterial cultures under identical conditions.
entries.zh: 实验室在相同条件下比较了两份分枝杆菌培养物。

entries.en: The examiners agreed to regrade the scripts after discovering an error.
entries.zh: 发现一个错误后，考官们同意重新评定试卷等级。

entries.en: The museum displayed a stereograph beside its original viewing device.
entries.zh: 博物馆把一张立体照片与原来的观看装置并排展出。

entries.en: The essay traces the institutionalisation of a once informal volunteer network.
entries.zh: 这篇文章追溯了一个原本非正式的志愿者网络的制度化过程。

entries.en: The teaching collection contains several orthoses from different periods.
entries.zh: 教学藏品中有几个不同时期的矫形器。

entries.en: The report highlights the underutilization of the town's public buildings.
entries.zh: 报告强调了镇上公共建筑利用不足的问题。

entries.en: The shopgirl carefully wrapped the customer's fragile purchase.
entries.zh: 女店员仔细包好了顾客购买的易碎物品。

entries.en: The critic explores the doubleness of a character who is both rescuer and betrayer.
entries.zh: 评论者探讨了一个既是救助者又是背叛者的角色的双重性。

entries.en: A thirtyish man offered to help carry the heavy suitcase.
entries.zh: 一个三十岁左右的男人主动提出帮忙搬重箱子。

entries.en: The veterinary researcher examined a preserved heartworm specimen.
entries.zh: 兽医学研究人员检查了一份保存的犬恶丝虫标本。

entries.en: The historical exhibit included a sealed container of birdshot.
entries.zh: 历史展览中有一个密封容器，里面装着小号铅弹。

entries.en: The examiner rewrote a distracter that no student had selected.
entries.zh: 考官改写了一个没有学生选择的干扰选项。

entries.en: The children ran towards the playland beside the picnic area.
entries.zh: 孩子们跑向了野餐区旁的游戏场。

entries.en: The engineer tested the biosensor with a fresh reference sample.
entries.zh: 工程师用一份新的参照样本测试了生物传感器。

entries.en: The study compares the metallicity of the two materials.
entries.zh: 这项研究比较了两种材料的金属性。

entries.en: A faint plink came from the piano in the next room.
entries.zh: 隔壁房间的钢琴传来一声轻轻的叮响。

entries.en: The essay stresses the multidimensionality of poverty rather than income alone.
entries.zh: 文章强调贫困的多维性，而不只看收入。

entries.en: The medical atlas compares osteoporotic bone with a healthy specimen.
entries.zh: 医学图谱把骨质疏松的骨骼与健康标本作了比较。

entries.en: She aproned the children before they began painting.
entries.zh: 孩子们开始画画之前，她给他们穿上了围裙。

entries.en: The workshop's cupboard contained a labelled bottle of degreaser.
entries.zh: 车间橱柜里有一瓶贴着标签的去油污剂。

entries.en: He looked at the champion challengingly but said nothing.
entries.zh: 他挑衅地望着冠军，却没有说话。

entries.en: Her unserious answer irritated the interviewer, who repeated the question.
entries.zh: 她不严肃的回答惹恼了采访者，对方又问了一遍。

entries.en: Their weekly coffee klatch gradually became a neighbourhood tradition.
entries.zh: 他们每周的咖啡闲聊聚会逐渐成了街坊的传统。

entries.en: A squirmy caterpillar wriggled across the leaf in her drawing.
entries.zh: 她的画中，一条蠕动的毛虫在叶片上爬行。

entries.en: The team tested an optoelectronic sensor in the darkened laboratory.
entries.zh: 团队在调暗光线的实验室里测试了一个光电子传感器。

entries.en: The essay treats the court as a definer of legal boundaries.
entries.zh: 文章把法院视为法律边界的定义者。

entries.en: The historian links the regime's delegitimation to its repeated broken promises.
entries.zh: 历史学家把该政权的合法性丧失与它反复违背承诺联系起来。

entries.en: The antique shop devoted an entire room to Victoriana.
entries.zh: 古董店把整整一个房间用于陈列维多利亚时代文物。

entries.en: The medical teaching display included an external fixator beside a bone model.
entries.zh: 医学教学展台在骨骼模型旁陈列了一个外固定器。

entries.en: He hung his dusty Stetson on a peg beside the door.
entries.zh: 他把落满灰尘的斯泰森毡帽挂在门旁的钩子上。

entries.en: The ironmaster walked through the foundry with a visiting engineer.
entries.zh: 铁工厂厂长陪同一位来访工程师走过铸造车间。

entries.en: The batter swung too early at the pitcher's fadeaway.
entries.zh: 击球手面对投手的低速曲球，挥棒过早。

entries.en: The final subchapter summarises the report's recommendations.
entries.zh: 最后一个分节概括了报告的建议。

entries.en: The survey asked participants whether they had purchased a nutraceutical.
entries.zh: 调查询问参与者是否购买过保健食品。

entries.en: We shared a steaming bowl of udon after the long walk.
entries.zh: 长途步行后，我们分吃了一碗热气腾腾的乌冬面。

entries.en: The system keeps reviewable records of every change to the file.
entries.zh: 系统为文件的每次修改保留了可供审查的记录。

entries.en: The teacher shaded a lune between the two curved lines.
entries.zh: 老师把两条曲线之间的半月形区域涂上了阴影。

entries.en: The novel's charming lovelace leaves a trail of broken promises.
entries.zh: 小说里那个迷人的浪子留下了一连串未兑现的承诺。

entries.meaningZh: 有造诣的；非常熟练的〔旧式拼写〕
entries.en: She was a compleat musician who could arrange, conduct, and perform.
entries.zh: 她是一位造诣全面的音乐家，能够编曲、指挥和演奏。

entries.en: The journal published a monographic study of the village's medieval records.
entries.zh: 这本期刊发表了一项关于该村中世纪档案的专题研究。

entries.en: The surveyor measured the vessel's freeboard before completing the report.
entries.zh: 验船师在完成报告之前测量了这艘船的干舷。

entries.en: The mechanic inspected the reverser before starting the locomotive.
entries.zh: 机械师检查了换向器，然后才启动机车。

entries.en: The laboratory compared the samples under uniaxial loading.
entries.zh: 实验室在单轴载荷下比较了这些样本。

entries.en: The essay examines the poet's imagistic treatment of the winter landscape.
entries.zh: 文章分析了诗人对冬日景色所作的意象派处理。

entries.en: The spacecraft turned sunward before the camera began recording.
entries.zh: 摄像机开始记录前，航天器先转向了太阳。

entries.en: The film presents the shy librarian as an unlikely dreamboat.
entries.zh: 电影把那位害羞的图书管理员塑造成一个出人意料的梦中情人。

entries.en: The nightwatchman noticed a light in the supposedly empty office.
entries.zh: 守夜人在本应空无一人的办公室里发现了灯光。

entries.en: The students reasoned inductively from several observed cases.
entries.zh: 学生们从几个观察到的案例出发进行归纳推理。

entries.en: The costume's long cape gave him a distinctly vampiric appearance.
entries.zh: 戏服上的长斗篷让他明显有了吸血鬼般的外观。

entries.en: The archive preserves early cinematographic equipment alongside production notes.
entries.zh: 档案馆把早期电影制作设备与制作笔记一同保存。

entries.en: She placed a fresh elderflower in the botanical display.
entries.zh: 她在植物展台上放了一朵新鲜的接骨木花。

entries.en: The philosopher questioned the universalization of one society's moral rules.
entries.zh: 哲学家质疑把一个社会的道德规则普遍化的做法。

entries.en: The instrument's readings improved after careful recalibration.
entries.zh: 仔细重新校准后，仪器的读数改善了。

entries.en: The pony followed docilely as the child led it across the yard.
entries.zh: 孩子牵着小马穿过院子，小马温顺地跟着。

entries.en: The historian traced the resegregation of schools after earlier integration efforts.
entries.zh: 历史学家追溯了学校在早期融合努力之后重新出现种族隔离的过程。

entries.en: He manically rearranged the furniture while everyone else tried to rest.
entries.zh: 大家都想休息时，他却狂躁地重新摆弄家具。

entries.en: The chemist drew a tricyclic compound on the board.
entries.zh: 化学家在黑板上画出了一个三环化合物。

entries.meaningZh: 自行车〔英式非正式用语〕
entries.en: He left his pushbike beside the village post office.
entries.zh: 他把自行车停在村邮局旁。

entries.en: A young journo interviewed the volunteers outside the community hall.
entries.zh: 一位年轻记者在社区礼堂外采访了志愿者们。

entries.en: A heavy stewpot stood on the shelf above the cooker.
entries.zh: 一个沉重的炖锅放在炉灶上方的架子上。

entries.meaningZh: 黏糊脏东西〔英式非正式用语〕
entries.en: The mechanic scraped black gunge from beneath the old engine.
entries.zh: 机械师从旧发动机下面刮出了黑色黏糊脏物。

entries.en: The review praised the pianist's expressivity rather than technical brilliance alone.
entries.zh: 评论赞扬了钢琴家的表现力，而不只是技术上的精湛。

entries.en: She placed a ripe redcurrant on top of each small tart.
entries.zh: 她在每个小馅饼上放了一颗成熟的红醋栗。

entries.en: The children preferred crustless sandwiches for the picnic.
entries.zh: 孩子们野餐时更喜欢没有面包硬皮的三明治。

entries.en: The shop replaced its winter coats with lightweight leisurewear.
entries.zh: 商店把冬大衣撤下，换上了轻便的休闲服。

entries.en: The dog's coat showed a rich brindle in the sunlight.
entries.zh: 阳光下，狗的皮毛显出了浓重的斑纹。

entries.en: A sudden drumroll silenced the hall before the prize announcement.
entries.zh: 奖项公布前，一阵突然的鼓声让大厅安静了下来。

entries.en: She borrowed a videocam to record her grandfather's stories.
entries.zh: 她借了一台摄录机，录下祖父讲的故事。

entries.meaningZh: 老妇人〔苏格兰旧时用语〕
entries.en: An old carlin in the tale guards the bridge with a riddle.
entries.zh: 故事里，一位老妇人用一道谜语把守桥梁。

entries.en: The knitted bear was soft, round, and wonderfully huggable.
entries.zh: 这只针织熊又软又圆，让人特别想抱住它。

entries.en: The workers will backfill the trench after the pipe inspection.
entries.zh: 管道检查后，工人们会回填沟槽。

entries.en: The play opens in a narrow, gaslit street.
entries.zh: 这出戏以一条由煤气灯照明的狭窄街道开场。

entries.en: The rider withdrew from the enduro after damaging his motorcycle.
entries.zh: 摩托车受损后，那位车手退出了长距离耐力赛。

entries.en: The biology class discussed a mutualistic relationship between two species.
entries.zh: 生物课讨论了两个物种之间的互利共生关系。

entries.en: The engineer first analysed the structure statically, without considering motion.
entries.zh: 工程师先对结构作了静态分析，没有考虑运动。

entries.en: A rocky morro rose above the sheltered bay.
entries.zh: 一座岩石岬角耸立在避风海湾之上。

entries.en: The gardener photographed a hornworm clinging to a leaf.
entries.zh: 园丁拍下了一只紧贴叶片的天蛾幼虫。

entries.en: The lecture compared different methods of measuring intraocular pressure.
entries.zh: 讲座比较了测量眼内压力的不同方法。

entries.en: The marchese lent his family's old maps to the museum.
entries.zh: 侯爵把家族的旧地图借给了博物馆。

entries.en: A wooden path crossed the fenny ground behind the village.
entries.zh: 一条木制小路穿过了村后的沼泽地。
